scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:deploy:master: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=prisma-master/schema.prisma
